items.text: Kopup ŋesi akiro nuka odwe luka Laban, ebalas ebe, “Kidema Yakob iboro kere luaraas luka papawok: ido kaŋul luaraas luka papawok kes adumunia abar ŋin kere.”
Koany Yakob akonyen nuka Laban, ido koany, itegelikina kamaken,
Kotema EJAKAIT Yakob atiar, “Koboŋo akwap naka lukapapaakon, mama ejaas iinacanakon, ajaenena eoŋ kajo.”
Kiyakia Yakob konyarau Rakel ka Lea kopotu orony neejai esipan.
Kotema atiar, “Aany akonyen nuka papakus itegelikina kamaka; konye Edeke loka papaka ejaenena keoŋ.
Ido ijenete cut ebe abu kejaanak papakus kakagogon kere.
Ido papakus abu kenala, kilocenenei ekaropit irwan atomon; konye mam Edeke abu kocamak aiswamakin eoŋ aronis.
Naetemaria kwana ebe, ‘Numerieik, kes eraunos ekoniropit’; kouri esipan kere numerieik: ido naetemaria ebe, ‘Nupusieik kes eraunos ekoniropit’; kouri esipan kere nupusieik.
Kwaŋin abu Edeke kodema papakus ikebaren, kainak eoŋ.
Kosodi kapaarasia kanun, kiwacu esipan, keteluo akakonye, kaany kotoma airuja, ido koany, ikorwa luakwarete esipan araas lupusieik, ka lumerieik, ka luenirooko.
Emalaika da loka Edeke kalimok kotoma airuja ebe, ‘Yakob’; katema atiar, “Eoŋ lo.’
Kotema atiar, ‘Kiteluo kwana akonikonye, koany ikorwa kere luekwarete esipan lupusieik ka lumerieik ka Iuetjirooko; naarai aany kere nukiswamanakini Laban,
Arai Eoŋ Edeke loka Bet-el, nekolo ibukokinia akinyet opir, nekiyapoikinio eoŋ aiyaposit; aso do konyou, kolot kakwap kana, kobono akwap nakolo kiwurikinio.’’’
Kobonokis ŋes Rakel ka Lea kotemasi atiar, “Eroko bobo isio kiia kakorakinet arai airumet kotogo loka papakosi?
Mam kimarakinit ŋesi sio olonwao? Naarai abu kogwela sio, anyamar da cut ikosiboro.
Naarai abara kere naademaa Edeke papakosi ŋes nawok, ka naka idwcwok: asa do nuadau Edeke alimokin jo, kiswama.”
Konyou Yakob, kisibwanenik ikedwe ka akenor kuju akaalai;
Koyana ibaren kere, ka iboro kere luatukonokinit, ibaren luabu kodumunite, luatukokinit koPadan-Aram, alosit mama ejai Isaak papake akwap naka Kanaan.
Alosit Laban aitub ajul nuka amerekekinike; kokokwa Rakel aputosia nuka idekesio nuka papake.
Kidadaar Yakob komam Laban Esuriat Ejeŋi, naarai mam abu kolimok elosi.
Kwaŋin koker kiboro kere luajaatar; konyou, kikwaijar kocor, kobea oroŋat loka Gilead.
Aponi kolimokinai Laban kapaaran kanakiwuniet ebe asi Yakob.
Kouparos kikeinacan, kibwapak ŋes apaarasia akanykaarei; kodumak oroŋat loka Gilead.
Kobu Edeke mama ejai Laban Esuriat kotoma airuia kuare, kotema atiar, “Kocoite, sirikiner kaYakob nuejok karaida nuereko.”
Kodolok Laban Yakob. Ebubukinit Yakob ekewema oroŋat; Laban da ka ikeinacan kibubukis oroŋat loka Gilead.
Kotema Laban Yakob atiar, “Ibu kiswama nyo, aisi komam eoŋ ajeni, kosodi ayaŋaar cut adweka kwape nuunatan kekileŋ?
Kanukinyo kisia, aidadaar kamaka; komam kilimokinit, tikatwarit kaboliasia ka ikososio ka isiman ka adeudeu?
Kwabo mam ibu kisunup eoŋ ainu ikadwe lusap ka lupesur? Iswama do nuka abaŋaanut,
Ejai eoŋ apedor aiswamakin jo erono: konye Edeke loka papakon ŋes kinera keoŋ kuare ebe, ‘Kocoite, sirikiner kaYakob nuejok karaida nueroko.’
Natikwana da karaida kikoto alosit, naarai kimuit ijo ere loka papakon itia bo inyo kikokwaria ikadekesio?”
Koboŋok Yakob kotema Laban atiar, “Naarai abu-kakurianar, ebe elemuni jo kodema eoŋ adwekon kagogon.
Ŋin yenidumuni ijo ejaas kikonidekesio, mam ejari; kotiaka ijo yenikon yenejai keoŋ kakonyen nuka iwokoinacan, koyana.” Naarai mam Yakob kejeni ebe kekokounit Rakel kes.
Koloma Laban owema loka Yakob, owema da loka Lea, owema da loka abulesin aarei, konye mam abu kodum kes. Kolom kowema loka Lea, koloma owema loka Rakel.
Kwabo kelemarit Rakel aputosia nuka idekesio, kibwaik kes oboro luka akaalai, kiboikin kes, kinanyinany Laban ewema kere, konye mam edumuna kesi.
Kotema papake atiar, “Sirikinyunyurikin ejakaitika kanu mam apedoro anyoun kakonyenekon, naarai ebami eoŋ.” Komo, konye mam edumuna aputosia nuka idekesio.
Konyunyurikin Yakob, konolopata kaLaban: Koboŋok Yakob kotema Laban atiar, “Anibo akaronis? Akadiakaret anyoin, kibwapitor arukitor eoŋ?
Naarai inanyinany ikaboro kere, inyo bo idum ijo koboro lukotogokon kere? Kibwaik ne akonyen nuka ikainacan, ka ikoniinacan, kotubokis oni luarei.
Ikar nul akaisaarei kiia kajo; amerekekinikon, ka akineikon mam eiecununete ikalei, imaseniko da luka esipan mam eoŋ elilanari.
Yenapoopooenenei ctian mam kainununei jo, eoŋ katwanianari nin, ibu kitepesenenei eoŋ arai kekokwar paaran, arai kekokwar kuare.
Kaiai kwaŋin; paaran kaarite akure noi, ka aterot kuare; kikolerito akakonye.
Ikar nul akaisaarei ajai togokon; abu kejaanak ikar itomon ka luoŋon kanuka adwekon, ikar ikanykape da kanuka esipanikon; ibu kilocenenei ekaropit irwan atomon.

Kedim Edeke loka papaka, Edeke loka Aburaam, ka Aiyoŋ naka Isaak ajaut keoŋ, timam kikurwok aiiukar eoŋ kwana titai. Abu Edeke koany akaiticanitoi, ka aitaaritoi naka akaninika, kiretak jo bian kuare.”
Koboŋok Laban kotema Yakob atiar, “Apcsur eraas akapesur, idwe eraas ikadwe, isipanin da ikasipanin, kere luiseseni eraas luka; eswamakini nyo lolo akapcsur nu, arai ikecedwe luapotu kouriata?
Aso do, ketutukot aitutuket, eoŋ ka jo, korai akajenan neaiai eoŋ ka jo.”
Koyana Yakob amoru, kosipok araut epir.
Kotema Yakob ikeinacan atiar, “Kotukokisi amoru.” Koyaata amoru, kotukokisi atukot; konyamata kidunyasi katukot.
Yegar-sakaduta Apolouke toma Aramaik Atukot nakaienan.
Galeed Apolouke toma Aburanian Atukot nakajenan.
Kotema Laban atiar, “Atukot na ŋes akaienan neajai eoŋ ka jo lolo.” Ŋes kemaikinere ekekiror Galeed.
naarai kotema atiar, “EJAKAIT kidara eoŋ ka jo, namam kianyununor bobo.
Arai kinaru ijo akapesur, arai kimany ijo acenor kinye apesuruka, emamei ecetuŋanan kaoni; koany, Edeke ŋes ekaienan neajai eoŋ ka jo.”
Kotema Laban Yakob atiar, “Koany atukot na, ido koany epir, luasipok eoŋ kidinika ka joo.
Korau atukot na akajenan, ido epir korau ekajenan, ebe mam atubi eoŋ atukot na abunore mama ijai, ijo da mam itubi atukot na ka epir lo abunore mama ajai, kanuka aronis.
Edeke loka Aburaam, ido Edeke loka Nakor, Edeke loka papakec, kotub kokidiniwok.” Kiyapo Yakob kolimite Aiyoŋ naka papake Isaak.
Koinak Yakob asubanit koronat, konyarau ikeinacan ainyam atap; konyamata atap, kiboioto akuare kiya koronat.
Kodilok Laban ainu ikedwe lutelepai ka lupesur, kilipak arereŋ; konyou Laban, kobono aiboisike.
